name: Cisco Systems, Inc.
summary:
Cisco Systems (CSCO) reported earnings of $1.08 per share on revenue of $15.84 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended April 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.04 per share on revenue of $15.58 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.06 per share. The company beat expectations by 1.89% while revenue grew 11.96% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fourth quarter non-GAAP earnings of $1.16 to $1.18 per share on revenue of $16.70 billion to $16.90 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.09 per share on revenue of $15.79 billion for the quarter ending July 31, 2026.

"Cisco delivered record quarterly revenue in Q3 and we saw very strong, broad-based demand for our products, demonstrating the relevance of our technology for connecting and securing AI," said Chuck Robbins, chair and CEO of Cisco. "Cisco is well-positioned as the critical infrastructure for the AI era, building on our technology leadership and customer trust, while innovating at the speed and scale that our dynamic world demands."

Cisco Systems Inc is engaged in designing, manufacturing and selling of Internet Protocol (IP) based networking products and services related to the communications and information technology (IT) industry.
subject: Cisco Systems Beat Expectations
